opening.argument: The opportunity is explicitly tied to buying a package and recruiting through a sales team: profit and bonuses require purchasing one of five packages, while the network bonus is based on the weaker side of that team. Matching bonuses can extend across generations, making recruitment-linked commissions central to the offer. The presentation also promises profit as OneCoin tokens increase in price and promotes educational packages as a route to trading for profit, alongside a direct appeal to become a cryptocurrency millionaire. Taken together, these are active claims to buy in for bonuses and profit through a tiered team structure, not a warning or neutral description.
